properties.journal_id: Opaque public nonidentifying identifier; not a consent_ref
properties.sequence: Positive integer, strictly increasing for a given journal
properties.chain_head_sha256: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; computed from private local N39AuditJournal
properties.previous_anchor_commit_sha: Full 40-character SHA of previous independently witnessed anchor commit, except first anchor
properties.source_commit_sha: Full source commit SHA for the audit journal logic
properties.recorded_at_utc: RFC3339 timestamp, observed at publication; no retroactive time claim
properties.phase: INTENT or OUTCOME; never signifies actual owner approval by itself

restrictions: No names, email addresses, approval tickets, consent references, secrets, HMAC, raw grant files, or artifact payloads
One new file per checkpoint; no overwrite/delete
Commit must be confirmed as descendant of prior witnessed commit
Requires an external independently held commit witness and protected GitHub branch
Do not treat GENESIS as a genuine grant or operational audit
